description: Yearly USD total pay by level (median, mean, p10, p90) and mean base, stock and bonus. Look up levels with get-company-levels first. Compare up to 5 companies for one role and location. Sign in outside ~40 major tech companies. Never guess slugs. Use search-job-families, search-locations or search-companies. REQUIRED arguments: jobFamilySlug, locationSlug, companySlugs. Array-typed arguments (companySlugs) must be passed as arrays, even for a single value.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

locationSlug.description: City, metro, country or region. For states, use a metro or country.

name: get-salaries-by-company-level
